assertions_evaluated.text: Derives {owner}/{repo} from the resolved PR's url field before checking anything else
Resolves origin's actual destination via git remote get-url origin piped through the documented sed -E strip-prefix/strip-.git command
assertions_evaluated.evidence: "git remote get-url origin | sed -E 's#^(https://github\.com/|git@github\.com:)##; s#\.git$##'" quoted literally, with the strip-prefix/strip-.git behavior explained

assertions_evaluated.text: Compares the resolved {owner}/{repo} against origin's actual destination and detects the mismatch
assertions_evaluated.evidence: "Compare the two: Resolved from gh pr view: someorg/some-fork; Resolved from origin: ... not someorg/some-fork ... These do not match. Step 16.5(b) stops here."

assertions_evaluated.text: Stops and reports the bypass was not attested because gh pr view resolved a different repository than origin, naming GH_REPO/gh repo set-default as the likely cause
assertions_evaluated.evidence: "That GH_REPO (or a local gh repo set-default) is the likely cause, since it's what redirected the bare gh pr view call away from origin's own repository"

assertions_evaluated.text: States plainly that the push already succeeded and is unaffected -- only the attestation is skipped
assertions_evaluated.evidence: "The report names GH_REPO ... as the likely cause and states the push itself is unaffected -- only the attestation step was skipped"

assertions_evaluated.text: Never proceeds to the shared protocol's steps 1-5 on the mismatched PR, and never treats the coincidentally-passing isCrossRepository/headRefOid checks as sufficient on their own
assertions_evaluated.evidence: "Because (b) stopped the procedure, steps (c)-(g) ... are never entered. No gh pr comment, no gh api ... no label mutation"; "The skill does not treat either of these two coincidentally-passing checks (isCrossRepository and the would-be headRefOid match) as sufficient on their own to proceed"
